title: refactor: modernize CI build matrix, consolidate lint/test/release workflows
author: Marcus Lin
description: Motivation: Reduce CI runtime, remove duplicate workflows across repositories, and improve reliability and cache effectiveness while upgrading GH Actions and common deps. This PR consolidates multiple lint/test/release workflows into a unified, opinionated pipeline; modernizes the build matrix to avoid combinatorial explosion; upgrades commonly used actions to their latest stable majors; and improves caching and parallelism heuristics. Scope: .github/workflows/ci-unified.yml (new unified pipeline), .github/workflows/release-please.yml (release automation), scripts/ci/cache-utils.sh (helpers), docs/ci.md (developer-facing guidance), package.json and pyproject.toml bumps for dev deps, and removal of legacy workflows in .github/workflows/*.old.yml. Risk: moderate - CI changes can affect all repos; mitigations included path filters, staged rollout via branch protection, and toggles for self-hosted heavy jobs. Migration notes: teams using the old per-package workflows should follow docs/ci.md and update local overrides; legacy workflows are left as .old for one release cycle before deletion.
commit_summary: chore(ci): add unified ci-unified.yml workflow with build/test/lint stages
chore(ci): add release-please workflow and config
feat(ci): cache key improvements and restore keys for node_modules and pip cache
refactor(ci): reduce matrix by moving slow integration tests to self-hosted runners
fix(tests): add retries for flaky integration tests observed after dep bumps
review_comments: Ava Chen: Please add a brief note in docs/ci.md about the new path filters and how they affect monorepo components.
Marcus Lin: Added docs/ci.md section and an example path filter that preserves per-package builds for changed packages.
Diego Morales: The matrix still includes node 14 in some places; can we drop EOL versions and use a strategy of 'include' only needed combos?
Marcus Lin: Dropped node 14 from the matrix and added an include list for legacy packages that require node 14; default matrix now targets node 18 and 20.
Priya Nair: Observed flaky integration test on CI run #4 - suggest adding retry and increasing timeout for the http-client tests.
Marcus Lin: Implemented retry logic and bumped timeout; CI run #6 passed all checks.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows into a single unified pipeline to reduce maintenance overhead and parallel job count.
Upgraded GitHub Actions (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, cache@v4) and improved cache keys for node and python deps.
Introduced release-please based release automation and removed legacy draft release tooling.
Reduced build matrix cardinality and moved slow integration tests to labeled self-hosted runners; teams should read docs/ci.md for migration guidance.
